(3) Returning to the hotel, the entrance is shown with clear signage. Inside the room, the woman demonstrates the luggage storage space under the elevated bed frame. (4) Close-up shots feature premium electronics including a Dyson remote being operated by a hand with a silver ring, and a black Dyson Supersonic hairdryer held over a white sink. The woman is seen sitting at a small table drinking from a water bottle, with a spread of Japanese convenience store food including sushi and salad. (5) The woman tests a gray massage pillow on a blue sofa, pressing a button that glows green.
